name: swarm of centipedes
desc: Swarm of Centipedes is a CR 0.5 beast.

actions.name: swarm
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], 0 ft., one creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm}'s space. Hit: [[/damage 4d4 piercing average]] damage, or [[/damage 2d4 piercing average]] damage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has half of its hit points or fewer. A creature reduced to 0 hit points by a [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} is &reference[stable] but &Reference[poisoned] for 1 hour, even after regaining hit points, and &reference[paralyzed] while poisoned in this way.
